newsitem.title: USA: USX-U.S. Steel says forms coke partnership.
newsitem.headline: USX-U.S. Steel says forms coke partnership.

text.p: The U.S. Steel Group of USX Corp said Monday that it has formed a strategic partnership for two limited partners to acquire an interest in three coke batteries at its Clairton Works in Pennsylvania and to operate and sell coke and byproducts from those facilities.
Proceeds to the U.S. Steel Group were about $360 million before taxes.
U.S. Steel Group said the transaction is not expected to have a material impact on its second quarter or full year 1997 net income.
Other terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
U.S. Steel Group said proceeds will be used for its general corporate purposes.
